Title: SEL-001 - Homepage displays the shop entry points
Step Action: Open the homepage and inspect its page title and catalog, cart, account, and event announcement links.
Step Expected: Raven Metal title is present; links point to index.php, shopping_cart.php, account.php, and article_info.php?articles_id=44.

Title: SEL-002 - Cookie notice can be accepted
Step Action: Open the homepage in a fresh browser session and accept the Hebrew cookie-consent notice.
Step Expected: Consent notice becomes visible, its button is interactable after the entrance animation, and the notice closes after acceptance.

Title: SEL-003 - Catalog product opens a detail page
Step Action: Open the homepage, accept cookie consent, and open a product detail link. Do not add the product to the cart.
Step Expected: Browser reaches a product_info.php?products_id=... route and the page displays a shekel price.

Title: SEL-004 - Event announcement opens its article
Step Action: Open the homepage and follow the Hebrew event announcement link לחצו כאן.
Step Expected: Browser reaches article_info.php?articles_id=44; page shows SEPTICFLESH, PARADISE LOST, or BLIND GUARDIAN and no not-found message.

Title: SEL-005 - Account and registration links reach their public pages
Step Action: Open the homepage, follow החשבון שלי, then follow the registration link. Do not enter credentials.
Step Expected: Login page opens and its registration link opens create_account.php.

Title: SEL-006 - Registration form exposes customer fields
Step Action: Open create_account.php and inspect the email, password, and named customer input/select fields. Do not submit the form.
Step Expected: Email field is present, two password fields are present, and the form exposes named customer fields.

Title: SEL-007 - Empty cart shows no items or payment controls
Step Action: Open shopping_cart.php directly in a fresh browser session and inspect the visible cart state.
Step Expected: Cart shows an empty/zero-item message and no payment step or payment control.

Title: SEL-008 - Public policy and accessibility pages load
Step Expected: Each page has a Raven Metal title and does not show a not-found message.
